Specification: This module is a small type-definition companion module for a typed two-phase commit specification. Its comment introduces a type alias for messages, stating that a message is one of Commit(NIL), Abort(NIL), or Prepared(RM), and the module itself defines a single trivial operator used as a placeholder. There are no state variables, actions, temporal properties, fairness conditions, proofs, or PlusCal processes in this file.
